photos.title: 504 Beaty Street, Conway, South Carolina
photos.what: A one-story red brick house with a dark metal roof, a brick chimney and a porch under brick arches, behind a row of low shrubs, on a street of older homes in Conway. Live oaks with Spanish moss hang over the roof. A United States flag and a South Carolina flag hang from the porch. No person is in the photo, and no sign or house number is readable.
photos.caption: A brick house on an older street in Conway (photo 2015).
photos.alt: A one-story red brick house with a dark metal roof and a porch under brick arches, behind low shrubs, under live oaks with Spanish moss, in Conway
